name: Magga
summary: Magga is an orc resident living in the Valley of Trials within Durotar. Stationed near the Den, she serves as a welcoming face for newly arrived Horde adventurers beginning their journey in the valley.

sections.title: A Welcoming Face in the Valley of Trials
sections.body: The Valley of Trials is the first taste of the world for young orcs and darkspear trolls. Positioned near the Den, Magga greets new arrivals to the valley. While she keeps a low profile among the valley's busy trainers and recruits, she helps bind the small camp together.

faq.answer: Magga is an orc civilian stationed in the Valley of Trials, Durotar. She stands near the Den, welcoming new Horde travelers.

faq.q: What is Magga's connection to Innkeeper Grosk?
faq.answer: No special tie between them is recorded. Magga stays in the Valley of Trials, while Innkeeper Grosk keeps the inn at Razor Hill, offering travelers food, drink and a place to bind their hearthstones.
Magga receives the 'Welcome!' errand: adventurers who carry a Valley of Trials Gift Voucher hand it to her, and she welcomes them to Azeroth with a small companion as a gift.

angles.text: For fresh recruits arriving in the harsh Valley of Trials, Magga provides a reassuring welcome to Durotar.
